query:
FROM logs-vigil-security
| WHERE host.name == "pay-svc-prod-01"
| WHERE user.name == "svc-payments-admin"
| WHERE @timestamp >= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-06T08:30:00Z") AND @timestamp <= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-06T08:45:00Z")
| WHERE event.action IN ("login", "connection", "upi_transfer")
| LOOKUP JOIN vigil-bank-context ON host.name
| STATS
    evidence_events = COUNT(*),
    suspicious_upi_total = SUM(vigil.transaction.amount),
    bank_exposure_inr = MAX(vigil.bank.exposure_inr),
    affected_accounts = MAX(vigil.bank.account_count)
  BY host.name, vigil.bank.service, vigil.bank.tier, vigil.bank.owner
boundary: The query is incident-scoped from the evidence envelope; it contains no hidden ground-truth tag or fixed IOC.
